856-5256-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

3764-6798-7924.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a Clue token due to Flitwing.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Clue.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-6559--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-6559--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2738-2921-4314-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Pawn of Ulamog, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4-1170-7499.easyPrerequisites: Pest Friend must have valid targets.
4-1170-7499.description:
Cast Pest Friend using the convoke ability from Hoarding Broodlord by tapping Lluwen, Exchange Student.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
Resolve Pest Friend.
Repeat.
4-1170-7499.notes: If you have a way to cause the infinite Pest tokens to die, this combo also produces infinite lifegain and infinite lifegain triggers.

3705-4050-6896-7729.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
The Vision and Scarlet Witch triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

413-586-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger, adding {B}{B}{B} and untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

560-4017-4050-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-4017-4050-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

2438-2692-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Felidar Retreat triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

339-677-2292-6965.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2544-3053.easyPrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
2544-3053.description:
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Temur Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

4753-5466.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Clever Impersonator's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Clever Impersonator's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Clever Impersonator's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-3781-4215--124.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-3781-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

575-1207-6620.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.
Resolve all Sylvan Safekeeper abilities.

500-1308-2523-4365.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mondrak and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Mondrak token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Mondraks dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Mondrak that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Mondraks you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-1308-2523-4365.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

778-3750.easyPrerequisites: Ancient Copper Dragon cannot be blocked by an opponent.
778-3750.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Ancient Copper Dragon, triggering it, causing you to roll a d20 and create that many Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat step 3 until you have {3}{R}{R} or run out of Treasures.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
778-3750.notes: This combo can fail if you roll less than a 5 and do not control enough Treasures to make up the difference. You can control creatures that tap for mana and/or have additional mana to start the combo and reduce the chance of failure. You can also carry over Treasures from prior iterations to cover the difference.

2232-5334-6470.notablePrerequisites: You control and own a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana.
2232-5334-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve the Iridescent Tiger triggers, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Resolve the first Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning a nontoken nonartifact creature that can be cast using at most six in any combination of {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{G}{G} mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Cast the creature returned to your hand by paying its mana cost. 
When the creature enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers twice, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand with the first trigger and returning nothing with the second trigger.
Repeat.

1447-1734-5686.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

575-1126-5971.easyPrerequisites:
ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
There is a black card in your graveyard.
575-1126-5971.description:
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it.
When Xiahou Dun dies, Yedora triggers, returning Xiahou Dun from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Xiahou Dun enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Xiahou Dun by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Xiahou Dun face-up.
Repeat.
Resolve all Xiahou Dun abilities.

224-1359-1683-5621.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
224-1359-1683-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Penance by putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Arid Archway on top of your library.
Galadriel triggers, putting Arid Archway from the top of your library onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

628-5263-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve both Ravenous Intruder abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Pinnacle Monk

2665-4872-5913.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk.
When the token Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-3169-5539-5540.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to 1.
413-3169-5539-5540.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lucius the Eternal, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to 1.
When Lucius the Eternal dies, it triggers, exiling it from your graveyard and choosing the creature targeted in step 1.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, destroying it.
When the creature dies, Lucius the Eternal triggers, returning itself from exile to the battlefield.
When Lucius the Eternal enters the battlefield, Confusion in the Ranks, Blasting Station and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters the battlefield, Confusion in the Ranks and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Confusion in the Ranks trigger, exchanging control of the Myr and an artifact or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-3490-5346.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one artifact creature.
2034-3490-5346.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to add {R}.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1368-3883-4950.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
1368-3883-4950.description:
Cast Reforge the Soul from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {3}{R}{R} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing each player to discard their hand, then causing you to draw seven cards, then create seven Treasure artifact tokens for each opponent you have.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

500-2047-2557-4365.notablePrerequisites: You control a nonlegendary artifact creature that does not have Mechanized Production attached.
500-2047-2557-4365.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers.
Holding priority, cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying a nonlegendary artifact creature you control and creating eight token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Resolve the Mechanized Production trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

719-2380-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodline Keeper does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Xenograft.
719-2380-2534.description:
Activate Bloodline Keeper by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Xenograft, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

313-1601-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Illuminor Szeras.
You control another nontoken creature with mana value six or greater.
313-1601-2178.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value six or greater, adding at least six {B}.
The creature dies, triggering Illuminor Szeras, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning the creature with mana value six or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat.

1548-4034-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Yore-Tiller Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
1548-4034-4050.description:
Declare Yore-Tiller Nephilim as an attacker.
Yore-Tiller Nephilim triggers, returning Port Razer from your graveyard onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage with Port Razer and Yore-Tiller Nephilim.
Port Razer triggers, untapping each creature you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Port Razer, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat each combat phase.

143-2060-4120.description:
Activate Conductor of Cacophony by paying {B} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to each player and to each creature opponents' control and putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat until you have one life remaining.

uses.n: Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life

959-1637-1993-4423.notablePrerequisites:
Budoka Gardener does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Islands.
You control less than ten lands.
959-1637-1993-4423.description:
Cast Tidal Bore by returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Budoka Gardener.
Activate Budoka Gardener by tapping it, putting Mystic Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, triggering itself and Aesi.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, returning Tidal Bore from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Tidal Bore from the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2644-3652-4050-4763.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Ornithopter enters the battlefield, triggering Sai of the Shinobi, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Ornithopter.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding one mana of any color.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-4786.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-4786.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Claws of Gix to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Claws of Gix.
Cast Claws of Gix.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

958-1750-4084-5261.description:
Cast Part the Waterveil by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Part the Waterveil.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Part the Waterveil into your graveyard from exile.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dralnu by tapping it, giving Part the Waterveil flashback until end of turn.
Cast Part the Waterveil from your graveyard by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile Part the Waterveil.
Repeat from step 2.
